intent: Trimmed real WordPress workload (5 representative queries from docs/examples/wordpress/wordpress-collection.json): three high-frequency single-table PK lookups/updates that belong on DynamoDB, and a taxonomy join plus a GROUP BY aggregation that belong on the relational engine.

q_option_get.rationale: Extremely high-frequency single-table PK lookup on wp_options — canonical DynamoDB shape.

q_postmeta_point.rationale: High-frequency single-table point lookup by meta_key+post_id — canonical DynamoDB shape.

q_api_key_update.rationale: High-frequency single-table PK update on wp_woocommerce_api_keys — canonical DynamoDB shape.

q_term_join.rationale: Multi-table taxonomy JOIN requires relational join support DynamoDB cannot provide natively.

q_agg_group_by.rationale: GROUP BY aggregation over post_status is a relational-engine operation.
